scope: Public experimental MS/MS and raw LC-MS datasets useful for natural-product analysis across both polarities

polarity_precedence: unambiguous signed charge (+1/-1/1+/1-; bare positive magnitude ignored)
database_snapshot.interpretation: Coverage uses one runtime-identical polarity rule. Unknown and conflict counts are explicit; no spectrum is assigned from precursor m/z alone.

ingestion_policy.note: Published record counts overlap strongly. They must never be summed as expected unique additions.

last_verified_sources: GNPS official library and FBMN documentation
MoNA official downloads and license pages
MassBank official API and dated Zenodo release
MetaboLights and Metabolomics Workbench official repositories
CIeaD official merged MGF and supporting Tables S2/S3

sources.name: CIeaD ZenoTOF experimental natural-product library

local_msp_audit.policy: The four local MSP files were fully hashed and cross-validated as redundant peak evidence. Their Neg/Pos and CID/EAD filenames were not treated as authoritative because record membership overlaps heavily.

sources.metadata_policy: Polarity and instrument come from the official merged MGF; structures, formulae and NPClassifier labels come from supporting Tables S2/S3; local MSP membership is retained in quality_flags_json.
sources.action: Current validated import is complete. Future releases must use accession/structure/adduct/peak-fingerprint deduplication rather than blind append.

sources.name: MS-DIAL ESI(-) authentic-standard MSP kit
sources.action: Reconcile the complete source manifest against existing records; do not blindly re-import the 44,669 published records.

sources.name: RIKEN PlaSMA authentic-standard negative MS/MS
sources.action: First V7 acquisition target; import only after structure, polarity and accession validation.

sources.name: RIKEN PlaSMA plant-tissue bio-MS/MS
sources.action: Keep MSI level/provenance and prevent level 2–4 annotations from being presented as authentic-standard identifications.

sources.name: Fiehn/Vaniya Natural Products Library ESI(-)
sources.action: Audit the remaining source records and quarantine structure/adduct conflicts; much of the difference is expected overlap.

sources.name: Fiehn HILIC negative MS/MS
sources.action: Reconcile the small residual only; not a high-yield bulk import.

sources.name: ReSpect plant metabolite negative MS/MS
sources.action: Reconcile accessions and structures; prioritize records representing compounds currently positive-only.

sources.name: MetaboBASE negative MS/MS
sources.natural_product_relevance: Broad endogenous-metabolite coverage; filter for natural-product roles after import
sources.action: Download from the official MS-DIAL/Zenodo record, validate license and accession metadata, then deduplicate.

sources.name: GNPS NIH Natural Products Round 2 negative qTOF
sources.action: Retrieve MGF/JSON with GNPS accessions and license metadata; deduplicate against ALL_GNPS and MS-DIAL-derived records.

sources.name: GNPS community negative library (MS-DIAL package)
sources.action: Do not duplicate records already represented by ALL_GNPS; retain per-library license and quality tier.

sources.name: MassBank current negative-ion records
sources.action: Use a dated release, preserve accession/license, filter natural-product relevance, and deduplicate against MoNA/GNPS/MS-DIAL mirrors.

sources.name: MoNA current experimental LC-MS/MS collections
sources.natural_product_relevance: Includes BMDMS-NP, ReSpect, Vaniya/Fiehn, PFP NP, HCD natural-product, polyphenol and alkaloid collections.
sources.action: Download by named collection rather than the all-spectra dump; preserve the collection and license, exclude in-silico records from production, then deduplicate against existing mirrors.

sources.name: BMDMS-NP plant-specialized-metabolite library
sources.natural_product_relevance: Purpose-built plant natural-product library measured on Orbitrap and Q-TOF instruments.
sources.action: Obtain the current source release and audit its polarity partitions. Do not infer that the numerical difference from the publication is all new negative-ion evidence.

sources.name: MSnLib open multi-stage and MS2 libraries
sources.natural_product_relevance: Includes NIH natural products, TargetMol natural products, ENAMINE discovery/molecules and several multi-collision-energy collections; natural-product labels remain collection evidence, not universal proof for every molecule.
sources.action: Diff the separate POS/NEG MS2 manifests by USI and structure. Existing NIHNP, TargetMol, ENAMINE and MCE records must be reconciled before any import.

sources.name: MoNA focused natural-product collections
sources.natural_product_relevance: PFP NP (3,524), HCD natural product (1,947), Polyphenol NEG (145), TOF alkaloids NEG (150) and Alkaloids QE NEG (132) in the current MoNA snapshot.
sources.action: Import only missing accessions after checking collection license, structure consistency, ion mode and peak fingerprints; these focused libraries are small but chemically relevant.

sources.name: MassIVE/GNPS public raw LC-MS/MS datasets
sources.action: Select DDA/DIA datasets by acquisition metadata, retain sample/QC/blank roles, detect and align LC-MS features, create representative spectra, and keep reported annotations separate from authentic-standard evidence.

sources.name: MetaboLights public metabolomics studies
sources.natural_product_relevance: Cross-species raw studies and metadata can support plant, microbial and other natural-product reprocessing.
sources.action: Mine studies rather than treating submitted annotations as reference truth; preserve ISA metadata, raw-file provenance and study-specific licensing exceptions.

sources.name: NIH Metabolomics Workbench / NMDR studies
sources.natural_product_relevance: Searchable targeted and untargeted MS studies with raw files, experimental metadata and standardized RefMet nomenclature.
sources.action: Use the study metadata and raw files for controlled reprocessing. Repository metabolite tables and m/z searches are candidate context, not automatic spectral-library identity.
